ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

spec_provided_observability.name: UID
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Factory-OTP unique identifier; cross-card unique; used as the primary card-identity probe.

spec_provided_observability.name: ATQA
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Static 16-bit value advertising UID size + bit-frame anti-collision support; first ID surface revealed by a PICC.

spec_provided_observability.name: SAK
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 8-bit classification byte that, together with ATQA, classifies the PICC family per AN10833 §2.2.

spec_provided_observability.name: BCC
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Block check character per Cascade Level; bit-flip detection on the UID portion.

spec_provided_observability.name: ATS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: ISO 14443-4 Layer 4 capability descriptor (FSCI, FWI, DS/DR, CID/NAD, historical bytes); revealed only when SAK b6 = 1.

spec_provided_observability.name: GetVersion response
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 7-byte vendor-deterministic family + version snapshot for MIFARE Ultralight EV1 / Plus EV1/EV2 / DESFire EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light; recommended over ATQA/SAK for newer chips.

spec_provided_observability.name: Error / Anti-Collision counters in PCD chip
spec_provided_observability.purpose: PCD reader chip (CLRC663 / PN5180 / PN512) exposes CRC / framing / collision counters via its host bus — vendor-specific, not in 14443 itself.

scope_observability: RF logic analyzer + 13.56 MHz envelope probe (e.g. Riscure Inspector, Micropross MP500, Aleph 1 RF Sniffer) is the standard debug path — captures both PCD pause patterns and PICC subcarrier modulation amplitude/timing.
Subcarrier waveform on a high-bandwidth scope can directly confirm Manchester (Type A) vs BPSK (Type B) load modulation choice.
PCD's analog RX channel (envelope detector + subcarrier demodulator) is the only debug visibility on PICC behavior — the PICC itself has no test pads exposed once packaged.
PCD reader chips often expose a 'collision-bit position' register that pinpoints where the anti-collision divergence occurs.
ate_or_dft: No standard DFT / scan / JTAG path is exposed on the air interface or on the PICC IC. Wafer / package test for the PICC silicon uses internal scan + parametric pads visible only at probe / package test, never over RF. PCD reader chips typically expose JTAG / SWD for host-side debug — vendor-specific.
notes: AN10833 does not specify a debug architecture; it specifies the deterministic identification surface (ATQA / SAK / UID / ATS / GetVersion) that itself serves as the standard observability for a freshly-discovered PICC. Layer 4 PICCs additionally expose CID and FWI, which a PCD can probe to characterise capacity / latency budget. For protocol-level debug, the canonical instruments are RF logic analyzers + ISO 10373-6-compliant test antennas.
